runtime.note: The live runtime already carries the explicit suppressedGenericProfileIds contract. R1367 aligns the packaged/public consumer contract and adds behavioral evidence without changing live runtime behavior.

dispositions.item: Use pipefail so generator failures cannot be hidden by tee.
dispositions.evidence: The profile-quality workflow uses set -euo pipefail; R1367 retains and re-runs it.

dispositions.item: Replace broad unsafe-text validation with record/field-scoped validation.
dispositions.evidence: The current R1360 profile-quality generator performs scoped validation and R1367 re-runs the unsafe-public-display gate.

dispositions.item: Keep canonical alias, intentional generic suppression, and review hold as distinct identity states.
dispositions.evidence: R1367 explicitly carries suppressedGenericProfileIds in public/package contracts while retaining 100 aliases and zero review holds; regression tests keep the three states distinct.

dispositions.item: Prove suppressed generic identities cannot enter public discovery, claim, membership, entitlement, checkout, support-authority, or onboarding scope.
dispositions.evidence: R1367 regression proves the suppressed FirstBank generic is absent from the public directory and runtime scope, is noindex/nonclaimable, and exposes no claim/membership/checkout path. Runtime alias/scope protections remain active.

dispositions.item: Preserve live-smoke and regression coverage for first-time claim, free correction/removal, optional membership, aliases/suppression, /health, and /ready.
dispositions.evidence: Inherited R1351, R1359, R1360, current-successor, alias, claim and recovery suites passed on the R1367 candidate parent; R1367 adds focused mobile/profile-boundary coverage. Live postdeploy smoke remains required after deployment.

dispositions.item: Continue owner live review after Finding #203.
dispositions.reason: This is evidence-driven live review, not a missing code feature. New findings must be based on observed defects rather than manufactured release churn.

dispositions.item: Add internal alias-state reconciliation only if pre-R1360 retired IDs persist in runtime state.
dispositions.reason: No current evidence shows retired alias state requiring reconciliation. Runtime remains fail-closed; building an unused repair tool would be churn.

dispositions.item: Reduce coarse-location profiles when newer accepted PF evidence provides safer precision.
dispositions.reason: Local must not infer addresses or profile facts. Resume only with a newer exact accepted PF handoff containing materially improved public location evidence.

dispositions.item: Dedicated private reviewer entry/workspace isolated from ordinary claimant/member pages.
dispositions.evidence: The membership runtime serves a protected /review/ reviewer workspace with authorization-bound sessions and security controls; ordinary claimant navigation does not expose reviewer controls.

dispositions.item: Move reviewer workspace to a Franklin-controlled private hostname when authorized DNS/custom-domain tooling exists and security is preserved or improved.
dispositions.reason: No current owner authorization or accepted same-origin/security migration evidence requires this move. Existing protected reviewer workspace remains the qualified state.

dispositions.item: Minimize ordinary account/membership JSON responses while preserving user-facing behavior.
dispositions.evidence: R1367 runs the exact live runtime against a synthetic real Postgres database and verifies strict account/membership response shapes, no provider/customer/subscription leakage, active membership behavior, and fail-closed billing.

dispositions.item: Add real database-backed behavioral integration coverage for signed-in account, active membership, checkout recovery, and billing UI against minimized response shapes.
dispositions.evidence: R1367 response-minimization behavioral qualification passed using Postgres 16, the exact live runtime commit, synthetic data only, zero live Stripe calls, active membership assertions, billing fail-closed assertions, and legacy checkout recovery without duplicate provider-session creation.

dispositions.item: Preserve provenance, alias/no-fork, self-review/private-review, free-management, optional-membership, no-paid-factual-superiority and release identity gates.
dispositions.evidence: Inherited profile/claim/outreach/current-successor suites and R1367 focused gates pass without changing canonical PF truth or the $35/year optional-membership/free-rights boundary.

dispositions.item: Monitor real outreach recipients for claim completion, recovery, verification friction, Profile Center first value, optional membership conversion, support volume and alias regressions.
dispositions.reason: Local cannot fabricate production usage or send outreach. Continue from actual SRE-authorized outreach and privacy-safe observed product usage.

dispositions.item: Reconcile historical HIGH client telemetry only against fresh provider/runtime evidence.
dispositions.reason: No newly reproduced current product defect was established from stale telemetry during this run. Freshly reproduced defects remain actionable immediately.

dispositions.source: R1366 public consistency audit discovered in R1367
dispositions.item: Remove stale public statements that member PDF uploads are unsupported.
dispositions.evidence: Profile Center and Membership Status now match the R1366 reviewed PDF capability: max 4 MB, max 20 pages, unsafe active/encrypted/embedded/form-like PDFs rejected.

dispositions.item: Fix the homepage header/hero image on mobile without changing the laptop/desktop version.
dispositions.evidence: Only the <=620px phone breakpoint changes the hero-photo presentation. Desktop base stylesheet is locked byte-for-byte to the R1366 Git blob; all three desktop source images remain unchanged.

dispositions.item: Consume LI V51 / WO083 calendar-currentness work.
dispositions.reason: The SCC work order is persisted but dispatch/acknowledgement/acceptance has not been established. Generated or persisted does not equal dispatched or accepted; Local will not import nondispatched work.

dispositions.item: Resolve 34 prepared SRE cohort profile URLs returning 404 and complete point-of-send gates.
dispositions.reason: Canonical profile identity/publication belongs to Profile Factory and outreach execution belongs to SRE. Local must not invent profile identities or authorize sending.
